table.retrieve:
SELECT  A.saleinvcode,
	A.date,
	A.posted,
	A.amount,
	A.salealiasname,
	A.salecustname,
	A.remarks,
	Marked=( CASE WHEN ISD.issueinvcode is NULL THEN 'N'ELSE 'Y' end),
	issuerowid=max(A.issrowid),
	issueinvcode=ISD.issueinvcode,
	issueamount=isnull((select sum(qty*price) from issuedetail where issuedetail.issueinvcode=ISD.issueinvcode),0),
	issuedate=(select max(issueheader.date) from issueheader where issueheader.issueinvcode=ISD.Issueinvcode),
	issuecustomer=(select name from accounts,issueheader where accounts.acccode=issueheader.acccode and issueheader.issueinvcode=ISD.issueinvcode)

FROM
		(select saleinvcode=SL.saleinvcode,
			date,
			posted,
			amount=SL.invtotal,
			salealiasname=(select aliasname from accounts where accounts.acccode=SL.custcode),
			salecustname=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=sL.custcode),
			remarks=SL.remarks,
			issrowid=SD.issuerowid
		
		
		from 	saleLedger SL,
			saleinvdetail SD
		where 	SL.date>=:ar_StartDate and SL.date<=:ar_EndDate and
			SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode
		) as A LEFT OUTER JOIN Issuedetail ISD ON (A.issrowid=ISD.issrowid)
GROUP BY
	A.saleinvcode,
	A.date,
	A.posted,
	A.amount,
	A.salealiasname,
	A.salecustname,
	A.remarks,
	ISD.issueinvcode
ORDER BY
	A.saleinvcode
